name: Mikan Drill
description: A classic drill for practicing layups and touch around the rim. Alternate left and right hand layups continuously.

name: Stationary Dribbling Series
description: A series of stationary dribbling exercises: crossovers, between the legs, behind the back. Focus on keeping eyes up and maintaining a low stance.

name: Catch and Shoot
description: Practice catching a pass and immediately going into a shooting motion. Focus on footwork alignment and quick release.

name: Form Shooting
description: Shoot close-range shots focusing on proper form: elbow alignment, follow-through, and arc. Start 3 feet from the basket and gradually move back.

name: Spot-Up Shooting
description: Place cones at 5 spots around the three-point line. Shoot 5 shots from each spot, tracking makes and misses. Focus on consistent footwork and release.

name: Off-the-Dribble Pull-Up
description: Dribble toward a cone, execute a pull-up jumper, then repeat from different angles. Simulate game-speed movement before each shot.

name: Free Throw Routine
description: Shoot 10-20 free throws with a consistent pre-shot routine. Focus on rhythm, breathing, and muscle memory.

name: Two-Ball Dribbling
description: Dribble two balls simultaneously while walking or jogging. Alternate between same-time and alternating bounces to build coordination.

name: Cone Weave Dribbling
description: Set up 8-10 cones in a line. Weave through them using crossovers, between-the-legs, and behind-the-back moves at increasing speed.

name: Full-Court Attack Dribble
description: Sprint full court with the ball, executing a different combo move at each cone. Simulate game-speed transitions from backcourt to frontcourt.

name: Ball Handling Warm-Up
description: Light ball-handling exercises: ball wraps around waist, figure-8 through legs, fingertip taps. Get comfortable with the ball before intense drills.

name: Defensive Slide Drill
description: Perform lateral defensive slides across the court. Stay low in a defensive stance, keep hands active, and focus on quick lateral movement without crossing feet.

name: Closeout Drill
description: Sprint to a cone simulating closing out on a shooter. Chop feet on approach, get low, and contest with a hand up. Rotate to the next cone and repeat.

name: 1-on-1 Shell Drill
description: Simulate 1-on-1 defensive scenarios using cones as offensive players. Practice help-side positioning, on-ball pressure, and recovery rotations.

name: Zig-Zag Defensive Slide
description: Set cones in a zig-zag pattern. Defensive slide to each cone, drop step and change direction. Maintain low stance and active hands throughout.

name: Defensive Stance Hold
description: Hold a low defensive stance for 30-second intervals with 15-second rest. Focus on proper form: wide base, bent knees, straight back, and active hands.

name: Jump Rope
description: Jump rope at a moderate pace to elevate heart rate. Alternate between two-foot jumps, single-leg hops, and high knees every 30 seconds.

name: Suicide Sprints
description: Sprint to the free-throw line, half-court, far free-throw line, and full court, touching the line each time. Rest 30 seconds between sets. Complete 4-6 sets.

name: Ladder Agility Drill
description: Perform various footwork patterns through an agility ladder: in-out, lateral shuffle, icky shuffle, and single-leg hops. Focus on speed and precision.

name: Court Sprint Intervals
description: Alternate between 20-second all-out sprints and 40-second jog recovery for 10-15 rounds. Simulate the stop-and-go intensity of a real basketball game.

name: Dynamic Stretching
description: Perform leg swings, arm circles, hip openers, high knees, and butt kicks. Prepare the body for intense activity with full range of motion movements.

name: Cool-Down Stretching
description: Static stretches for major muscle groups: hamstrings, quads, calves, hip flexors, and shoulders. Hold each stretch for 20-30 seconds to aid recovery.

name: Resistance Band Lateral Walk
description: Place a resistance band around your ankles. Walk laterally in a defensive stance for 10 steps each direction. Strengthens hip abductors for lateral quickness.

name: Pound Dribble Warm-Up
description: Pound the ball hard into the ground alternating hands. Focus on keeping the dribble below knee height and maintaining a strong, controlled bounce.

name: Shooting Cool-Down
description: Take relaxed mid-range shots while walking around the court. No pressure, just feel the ball and focus on smooth shooting motion to cool down.

name: Step-Back Three
description: Dribble toward the three-point line, execute a step-back move to create space, and shoot. Practice from both wings and the top of the key. Focus on balance and separation.

name: Floater Finish Drill
description: Drive into the lane and release a soft floater over an imaginary defender. Alternate between left and right hand finishes from different angles.

name: Shooting Warm-Up Routine
description: Start with 5 layups each side, then 5 elbow jumpers each side, then 5 free throws. Gradually increase range to warm up shooting mechanics.

name: Hesitation Crossover Dribble
description: Set up cones as defenders. Approach each cone with a hesitation move followed by a crossover to change direction. Focus on selling the hesitation with a head fake and change of pace.

name: Speed Dribble Relay
description: Sprint with the ball through a course of cones, executing a combo move at each. Time each run and try to beat your personal best. Emphasize control at maximum speed.

name: Weak Hand Dribbling Series
description: Perform all dribbling moves exclusively with the non-dominant hand: pound dribble, crossover, between the legs. Build comfort and control with the weaker hand.

name: In-and-Out Dribble Move
description: Practice the in-and-out fake dribble to simulate driving then pulling back. Combine with a crossover or behind-the-back move to create separation.

name: Dribble Cool-Down
description: Light stationary dribbling with slow figure-8s and gentle ball wraps. Let heart rate come down while maintaining ball contact and soft touch.

name: Deny and Recover Drill
description: Set up cones to simulate an offensive player cutting. Practice denying the pass by maintaining an arm in the passing lane, then recovering to help position when the cone represents a drive.

name: Charge Drill
description: Practice setting your feet and taking a charge. Sprint to a designated spot, plant feet, square up, and absorb contact from an imaginary driver. Focus on timing and positioning.

name: Mirror Defense Drill
description: Face a partner or imaginary opponent and mirror their lateral movements. Stay in a low defensive stance, react to changes in direction, and maintain an arm's length distance.

name: Defensive Transition Sprint
description: Sprint full court simulating a transition defense scenario. Touch the baseline, turn and sprint back, find an imaginary ball handler, and get into defensive stance. Repeat 6-8 times.

name: Defensive Footwork Cool-Down
description: Slow lateral slides combined with deep breathing. Focus on maintaining perfect defensive form at a relaxed pace. Finish with static stretches for hip flexors and groin.

name: Box Jump Plyometrics
description: Perform box jumps onto a plyo box: 3 sets of 8 reps. Focus on explosive takeoff and soft landing. Add variations like single-leg jumps and lateral hops for advanced players.

name: Wall Sit Endurance
description: Hold a wall sit position with thighs parallel to the ground for 30-45 seconds, rest 15 seconds, repeat 4 times. Builds lower body endurance critical for maintaining defensive stance.

name: Bodyweight Circuit
description: Complete a circuit of 10 push-ups, 15 squats, 10 lunges each leg, 20 mountain climbers, and a 30-second plank. Rest 1 minute between rounds. Complete 3 rounds.

name: Defensive Shuffle with Ball
description: Perform defensive slides while maintaining a low dribble with the outside hand. Combines ball-handling with defensive footwork for multi-skill development.

name: Sprint-and-Shoot Conditioning
description: Sprint baseline to baseline, receive a pass (or self-pass off backboard), and immediately shoot a three-pointer. Track makes under fatigue. Repeat 10-15 times.

name: Lateral Bound Drill
description: Perform lateral single-leg bounds across the court, focusing on explosive push-off and controlled landing. 3 sets of 10 bounds each direction. Builds lateral power for defense.

name: Euro Step Finishing
description: Drive toward the basket and execute a Euro step around a cone defender. Practice finishing with both hands. Focus on the two-step footwork and body control in the air.

name: Defensive Warm-Up Jog
description: Light jog around the court transitioning into defensive slides at each baseline. Incorporate arm swings and hip openers to prepare for defensive drills.

name: Conditioning Cool-Down Jog
description: Light jog for 2 minutes followed by walking laps. Gradually bring heart rate down. Finish with deep breathing exercises and gentle arm and leg shakes.
